description: Causal probe: does classification DAPT compress discriminative info into top SVD components?
note: MLM-only used as vanilla baseline (server has no internet for HF download). Stronger control: isolates classification DAPT effect from fine-tuning.
evaluation: OOD jailbreak mixed with IID test benign (38 samples) for balanced binary classification
key_findings: 9-class model: perfect F1=1.000 on all OOD sets with just 3 SVD dimensions (out of 768). Discriminative info fully concentrated in compressed subspace.
MLM-only model: AA-OOD F1=0.636 even with full 768 dims. No discriminative structure from classification DAPT = no OOD generalization on hardest set.
Random projections systematically worse: 9-class random k=3 AA-OOD=0.928 vs top-3=1.000; MLM-only random k=5 DD=0.685, AA=0.584, FITD=0.744.
Scrambled model intermediate: AA-OOD=0.962 (some compression from partially-aligned labels), but random k=3 AA=0.766 (less stable).
DD-OOD and FITD-OOD are easily separable for all models (F1~1.0). ActorAttack (AA-OOD) is the discriminative test case.
Hypothesis CONFIRMED: classification DAPT creates a low-dimensional discriminative subspace that causally enables OOD jailbreak detection.
